description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order made to impose a Special Commodity Levy on Dried fish, Butter, Red Onions and etc., valid for a period of 06 month commencing from 02.04.2016
reasoning: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory details about tax rates on specific commodities, making it a legal/regulatory matter. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, this is only in his capacity as the authority issuing the order under the Act, and the content does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The primary purpose is to publish a regulatory order with detailed commodity classifications and tax rates.
